assets_dimensions.name: assets_dimensions
assets_dimensions.value: ("assets"."width" is null and "assets"."height" is null) or ("assets"."width" > 0 and "assets"."height" > 0 and cast("assets"."width" as bigint) * cast("assets"."height" as bigint) <= 40000000)

prompts_source_url.name: prompts_source_url
prompts_source_url.value: "prompts"."source_url" is null or (char_length("prompts"."source_url") <= 2048 and ("prompts"."source_url" like 'https://%' or "prompts"."source_url" like 'http://%'))
